title: PGC Constitution Schema V0
description: Closed machine-block contract for CONSTITUTION artifacts. core.enforcement_model discriminates how each rule's enforced_by must be expressed: a compiler-enforced rule names the INVARIANT that enforces it by FQDN; a process-enforced rule declares an explicit sentinel. Rule prose lives below the Machine fence.

enforcement_model.description: Determines the admissible shape of rules[].enforced_by.

governs.description: Artifact-type tokens this constitution governs. Read by assert_topology_surface_canonical_v0.

applies_to.description: What the rule governs — an artifact-type token, a lifecycle scope, or a list of either. The vocabulary is not yet normalized and the field has no consumer; it is constrained to shape only until it is promoted to load-bearing.

enforced_by.description: FQDN of the enforcing INVARIANT, or an explicit non-compiler sentinel. TBD is not admissible.

fqdn.description: Authoritative declared identity (namespace::code). Folder location has no authority over identity.

supersedes.description: FQDN of the artifact this one stands in place of. A declared relation between two exact identities, not a resolution rule: references stay exact, and a superseded artifact is unreachable rather than absent.

superseded_by.description: FQDNs of the artifacts that stand in this one's place. Several is the ordinary case — one act split in two retires one artifact and authors two. Its presence means the artifact is superseded: unreachable from the executable projections, retained in the canonical set as history.

authority.description: The authority from which this artifact's jurisdiction derives (CA-1, CA-2). Declared, never inferred from namespace, path or kind.

concern.description: The semantic subject this artifact is about (GO-11, ID-12). A concern classification confers no authority and constitutes no boundary.

constitutes_authority.description: The authority this constituting act constitutes (2e CA-2). An authority named by artifacts and constituted by nothing is refused.
